title: Ground Invasion of Iran
statement: We are preparing for a ground based invasion to secure the strait.
evidence_confirmed: American bases devastated by attacks (Breeds need for escalation)

Israeli PM Benjamin Netanyahu openly states in i24NEWS Hebrew interview (Sept 2, 2026): 'We will defeat the regime. All of Israel’s systems are working to overthrow this regime and defeat it,' directly linking external military actions to total regime collapse.

Primary juxtaposition (Sept 2, 2026): White House private leaks reveal leadership is discussing how to 'quiet quit' or declare the Iran war over to protect midterm optics, directly colliding with real-time reality as Iran launches surprise ballistic missile and drone strikes on U.S. assets in Kuwait—proving the kinetic flywheel cannot be stopped by political wishful thinking.
falsifier: No US ground invasion of Iran occurs - the strategy remains air/naval blockade + strikes (anvil), Iran is not invaded, and the regime either sues for terms or the war is quiet-quit/declared contained without boot on Iranian soil.
forward_watchlist: Any troop-deployment/readiness signal (division mobilizations, FORCOM activation orders) pointing at a ground option.
Whether the quiet-quit/November Pause strategy suppresses ground-invasion momentum (de-escalation) or the regime needs a decisive win (escalation).
Iran willingness to return to the interim ceasefire (Pezeshkian signal) - a genuine off-ramp that kills the ground option.
China mediation posture - active de-escalation (lowers ground probability) vs. disengagement (raises it).
Regime domestic optics: if they NEED a victory before midterms, ground invasion becomes likelier; if quiet-quit serves them, less.
